# HyperTune Garage - Automotive Detailing, PPF, Tuning & Maintenance

> HyperTune Garage is Pakistan's premier specialized automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics studio, Paint Protection Film (PPF) application center, and European/Japanese luxury car care facility located in Islamabad and Rawalpindi.

- [Home Page](https://hypertunegarage.pk/): Overview of HyperTune Garage workshops, specialized services, instant cost estimator, Google customer reviews, live workshop camera, and booking system.

- [Services Directory](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services): Comprehensive catalog of automotive services for German, European, Japanese, and hybrid vehicles.
- [Workshop Locations](https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations): Physical studio addresses, GPS directions, operational hours, and contact details for Islamabad and Rawalpindi branches.

- [Transformation Gallery](https://hypertunegarage.pk/gallery): Before & after showcase of full-body PPF installations, 9H Ceramic coatings, engine overhauls, and body kit modifications.

## Specialized Automotive Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf): 100% self-healing, anti-yellowing optical TPU paint protection film with computerized blade-free CAD plotter cut precision.
- [PPS Paint Protection System](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/pps-paint-protection-system): Multi-stage ceramic shield and polymer armor protecting vehicles against UV rays, acid rain, stone chips, and swirl marks.
- [Detailing & 9H Ceramic Coating](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/detailing-ceramic-coating): 3-step paint correction, deep hydrophobic graphene/ceramic coating, and interior steam deep cleaning.
- [Engine Overhaul & Mechanical Services](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services): Precision engine rebuilding, cylinder head resurfacing, timing belt/chain replacement, and performance tuning.
- [Periodic Maintenance & Lube Service](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/periodic-maintenance): Factory-scheduled oil changes with 100% genuine synthetic oils, filter renewals, spark plugs, and 45-point inspection.
- [Brakes, Suspension & 3D Alignment](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brakes-suspension-alignment): Ceramic brake pad replacement, hydraulic caliper repair, suspension bushing overhaul, and computerized 3D laser wheel alignment.
- [Transmission & Automatic Gearbox Services](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-gearbox-services): Dual-clutch (DCT), CVT, and torque converter gearbox diagnostics, fluid flush, and complete rebuilds.
- [Computerized Diagnostics & OBD Scanning](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/computer-diagnostics-scanning): OEM-grade diagnostic tools (BMW ISTA, Mercedes Xentry, VAG ODIS, Toyota Techstream) for precise fault finding and ECU coding.
- [Denting, Painting & Body Repair](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/denting-painting-body-repair): Computerized color matching paint booth, paintless dent repair (PDR), and structural chassis realignment.
- [Custom Body Kits & Aerodynamics](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-kit-custom-modification): Premium OEM and aftermarket body kit fabrication, diffuser installation, spoiler fitting, and custom exhaust fabrication.
- [AC Repair & Electrical Specialist](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-ac-repair): Complete automotive climate control servicing, R134a/R1234yf refrigerant recharge, cooling coil leak detection, compressor overhaul, and master auto-electrician wiring diagnostics.
